title: Derived open restriction and quasi-coherent cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an arbitrary open subscheme, and K an object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Choose derived categories on X and U with independent localization universes. Let R be the exact functor taking a module to its over-object at U and then applying the over equivalence to modules on U. Then R.mapDerivedCategory(K) has quasi-coherent cohomology if and only if, for every integer n, H^n(K).over(U) is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Tag 08DW, proof of (1) by compatibility with open restriction and the affine computation (2); Tag 06Z0

proof.text: The functor and inverse of the over equivalence preserve quasi-coherence: realize them as pushforwards along the equivalence of open sites. Continuity of Over.post follows from compatiblePreservingOfFlat and CoverPreserving.overPost. Apply Mathlib isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint using sheafOfModulesEquivOverUnit and its inverse-unit comparison.

Choose a representative complex P and e:Q(P) ≅ K via Q.objObjPreimageIso. Apply homology to R.mapDerivedCategory.mapIso(e.symm), then mapDerivedCategoryFactors at P, then homologyFunctorFactors, then mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso, and finally R.mapIso of homologyFunctorFactors.symm composed with homology(e). This gives H^n(R(K)) ≅ R(H^n(K)) for each n.

Transfer quasi-coherence along this isomorphism. For the forward direction apply the inverse over equivalence and then its inverse unit isomorphism. For the reverse direction apply the forward over equivalence and the inverse cohomology comparison. These implications hold for every n, proving the iff.

theorem schemeDerivedQCoh_openRestriction_iff (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wO} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty U.toScheme
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ↔
      ∀ n : ℤ, (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K).over U).IsQuasicoherent
